notes: One file changes: app/api/cartoonify/route.ts. No new dependency, no change to maxDuration, no change to lib/env.ts.

The measured success path is 35.06s against maxDuration=60, so the derived timeout is pinned at Math.floor(maxDuration * 1000 * 0.75) = 45000ms. Any smaller budget aborts requests that work today; criterion 7 enforces the arithmetic.
maxRetries is 0 and is forced, not chosen: one retry gives a 96s worst case against a 60s ceiling.

No criterion contacts the real provider. Every fault path is provoked by pointing OPENAI_BASE_URL at a local sink, so a full verification run spends zero upstream credit and does not depend on the provider misbehaving on cue.

Criteria 8-11 and 15 require the dev server to be restarted with fault-injection environment; run order is section 6.3 of the spec. Criteria 2 and 3 require no dev server running at all, since next build and next dev share .next.
No criterion depends on npm run lint, which cannot pass in this project (system finding 5; task 0001 criterion 4 waived under docs/adr/0003-criterion-4-waived.md).
UPSTREAM_ERROR's message still ends 'Lutfen tekrar deneyin' and is deliberately left unchanged; criterion 12 pins it so the question stays open rather than being quietly closed.
title: Bound the cartoonify route timeout to maxDuration, discriminate unreachable from size-degraded rejection, and stop the error message claiming a cause
